title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on this week's Israeli sports news, from a Melbourne Grand Slam flashback to Conference League penalty drama.

questions.question: On 26 January 2008, Jonathan Erlich and Andy Ram won Israel's first Grand Slam title. Who did they beat in the Australian Open men's doubles final?
questions.explanation: Erlich and Ram, seeded 8th, beat Clément and Llodra 7–5, 7–6(4) on 26 January 2008 to become Israel's first Grand Slam champions.

questions.question: Deni Avdija earned his first NBA All-Star selection in 2025-26 with the Portland Trail Blazers. What was his scoring average that season?
questions.explanation: Avdija averaged 25.5 points, 7.2 rebounds and 6.7 assists per game on 47/36/80 shooting splits in his All-Star 2025-26 campaign.

questions.question: How did Beitar Jerusalem advance past AEK Larnaca in their UEFA Conference League qualifier despite losing 2–3 after extra time?
answers: They won the penalty shootout 4–3 after a 3–3 aggregate score
AEK Larnaca were disqualified for fielding an ineligible player
questions.explanation: The tie finished 3–3 on aggregate after extra time in Ploiești, and Beitar won the shootout 4–3, with Omer Atzili scoring both Beitar goals.

questions.question: Who scored both Hapoel Tel Aviv goals in their 2–2 draw at Ludogorets that sent them through 4–2 on aggregate in the Conference League qualifiers?
questions.explanation: Emmanuel Boateng scored in the 16th and 58th minutes in Razgrad as Hapoel advanced 4–2 on aggregate after taking a 2–0 lead from the first leg.

questions.question: Rising guard Rani Belaga, just loaned by Hapoel Jerusalem to Hapoel Galil Elyon, captained which Israeli national team at this summer's European Championship?
questions.explanation: Belaga captained Israel's U20 team at this summer's European Championship and is reported to be the first Israeli player to record a triple-double at that event.
